_comment: Shape reference for config/services.json — the infrastructure we run and
publish. Without that file the Infra tab says nothing is published: an
endpoint we do not run must never be listed as one we do.
Every field below except chainId is optional, and anything left out is
The chain's own website and source repository are NOT set here. They come
from config/chains/<chainId>.json, because they belong to the project
seeds and peers are P2P addresses exactly as config.toml wants them,
<node-id>@<host>:<port>. They cannot be derived: an RPC endpoint knows its
own node id but not which host and port its P2P listener answers on.
Seeds are for discovery and get dropped once a node has peers; persistent
peers are held open — putting one in the other's slot gives you a node
that either never finds the network or clings to three addresses forever.
stateSync carries only the parts that are a choice. rpc_servers come from
the endpoints above, and trust_height and trust_hash are computed live on
every page load — a trust hash written into a config file is wrong within
days, and a wrong one fails the sync with an error that reads like a
